items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Well now I stayed there for a year and a half for Caesar Thompson, that was the Ramona nightclub.

ctx.x: In the walls. And then nothing will break the monotony, the same thing, over and over again, see? And I mean the trumpet always, he had to be the one to always pick up, he had to think, you see? He had to always, when that, alright, maybe the sax is finishing the number, maybe you done played two or three chords. If it's a short chords number, well you play three chords. If it's a long chords number, you just give the dancer two chords. And give them a three minute dance every nine days. Yeah, yeah, that's the…
